title: Can AI gains give alternative delivery providers an edge?
analysis: As parcel carriers like SpeedX and Veho deploy in-house AI tools, experts say the technology could help upstarts close the gap with FedEx and UPS.

title: EEOC moves to axe EEO-1 reporting
analysis: The agency wants to scrap a variety of employer reporting requirements, according to a plan sent to the White House in May.

title: Delivery reliability trumps speed, Macy’s and Ulta execs say
analysis: Maintaining on-time delivery promises will keep shoppers coming back, but fast shipping still has a role to play, retail leaders said at Home Delivery World 2026.

title: 3 logistics upgrades benefiting Wayfair
analysis: Leaders from the retailer detailed multiple initiatives at Home Delivery World 2026, from consolidating deliveries to automating driver calls to customers.

title: Deere recovers $272M in tariff refunds
analysis: All told, the farm equipment manufacturer still expects about $900 million in net tariff costs for the current fiscal year, executives said.

title: Starbucks ditches AI inventory system after just 9 months
analysis: The coffee giant is ending its computer vision inventory counting system — which employees called “unreliable” — in favor of traditional stock-keeping methods, Reuters reported.

title: Amazon wants sellers to be more precise with handling times
analysis: A new requirement aims to push sellers to offer more accurate delivery dates on self-fulfilled SKUs, which the company said can boost sales.

title: AutoZone’s distribution strategy drives sales gains
analysis: The auto parts retailer has made headway on faster store fulfillment as it continues to expand its roster of mega hubs.

title: Trump admin appeals aspects of tariff refund order
analysis: The Department of Justice said the Court of International Trade lacks the authority to mandate refunds for all finally liquidated entries.

title: Supreme Court decision raises stakes for broker hiring practices
analysis: The landmark decision found that a third party can be sued for negligent hiring, creating a shakeup in how brokers defend their businesses in future lawsuits.

title: Fleets Plan Bypass Around the Whole Network, Not Just the Easy Parts
analysis: Fleets run across a patchwork of state rules, enforcement patterns, and weigh stations that rarely look the same from one corridor to the next. Planning around those moving parts is where weigh station bypass strategy is headed.

title: Tenet Transportation Tech, Crown Data Systems Merge
analysis: Tenet Transportation Tech merged with Crown Data Systems, combining Tenet’s carrier operations software with Crown’s airfreight trucking software business.

title: Oil Rig Count Posts 6 Straight Gains, Longest Run Since 2022
analysis: U.S. oil drilling has expanded for six straight weeks, the longest uptrend in almost four years, after the Iran war pushed crude prices higher.

title: Horizon Eyes Class 8 BEV Tractor Production Inside 18 Months
analysis: Horizon currently sells Classes 3-7 battery-electric trucks but is expanding its portfolio with a Class 8 design intended to rival the Tesla Semi.

title: Hormuz Traffic Remains Near Zero as Peace Talks Stall
analysis: Iran is insisting on a ceasefire in Lebanon before it will accept a deal with the U.S. that’s meant to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and extend their truce by two months.

title: Commerce Backs Duties on Chinese, Mexican Van Trailers
analysis: The Commerce Department recommended levies be imposed on dry and refrigerated van trailers and subassemblies imported from China and Mexico after an investigation.

title: Oil Prices Continue to Slide
analysis: Brent crude, the international standard, gave up 2.2% to $92.97 per barrel. It was approximately $70 per barrel before the war began in late February.

title: High-Fashion Freight Draws High-Tech Thieves
analysis: Overhaul helped law enforcement recover a $187,000 shipment of designer goods in New Jersey. The criminals used strategic tactics to steal a blind load.

title: U.S., Mexico and Canada to Miss July 1 Date to Renew USMCA
analysis: By declining to formally renew, the Trump administration will trigger negotiations and an indefinite period of uncertainty about the future of the agreement.

title: OPEC Output Plunges Further as U.S. Squeezes Iran
analysis: Output from its 11 current members dropped by 1.22 million barrels to 16.33 million a day in May, with Iran accounting for more than half of the decline.
